extraction.name: Prompted Textures Dataset (PTD)
extraction.description: A synthetic texture dataset spanning 246,285 images across 56 texture classes, generated using text-to-image models (Stable Diffusion) guided by descriptive artistic prompts and filtered through a three-stage refinement process.
extraction.creator: Blaine Hoak, Patrick McDaniel
extraction.rai:dataCollection: Texture-specific prompts were constructed by combining words from five descriptor categories (artistic, spatial, color enhancer, color, and texture) across 56 texture classes, resulting in 96,768 unique prompts. The prompts were used as input to Stable Diffusion to generate five non-flagged images per prompt (initially 483,840 images).
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: Synthetically generated images produced using Stable Diffusion pipelines hosted via HuggingFace.
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: A three-stage refinement process was applied: (1) frequency filtering using Fourier transforms to retain the top 80% of images with high-frequency content to remove object-like images; (2) patch variance filtering across 50x50 non-overlapping patches to filter out the bottom 20% lowest mean patch variance images per class to remove homogeneous images; and (3) CLIP score filtering to discard the bottom 20% of images with the lowest prompt alignment scores. Images flagged by Stable Diffusion's NSFW safety filter were regenerated and excluded from the final release.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: For human evaluation, 9 participants evaluated 900 unique pre-refinement images (100 images per participant in random order). Participants rated two questions on a scale of 1 to 5: overall image quality and how well the image represented the provided descriptor, with an optional open-ended comment field.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationAnalysis: Mean quality and representativeness ratings were calculated across each refinement stage to measure gradual improvements, showing a 3.4% increase in quality and a 4.5% increase in representativeness overall. Participant comments were analyzed in conjunction with CLIP score quantile analyses.
extraction.rai:dataSocialImpact: Enables exploration of texture-based computer vision tasks, interpreting high-level features models learn, measuring and uncovering texture biases, and identifying security vulnerabilities like adversarial examples.
extraction.rai:dataBiases: Generation models exhibit lower performance when generating simple, structured textures (e.g., grid, polka-dotted) compared to complex textures commonly found in objects (e.g., hairy, flaky). Furthermore, Stable Diffusion's safety filter exhibits sensitivity bias toward benign abstract/texture descriptors, such as 'paisley'.
extraction.rai:dataLimitations: Simple and structured textures tend to achieve lower Inception and FID scores; specific descriptor combinations (such as pairing subtle textures with 'muted' or 'earthy') degrade image quality; NSFW filters frequently misclassify benign textures as explicit.
extraction.rai:dataUseCases: Measuring texture bias in computer vision models, computing Texture Object Association Values (TAV), analyzing feature representations, evaluating robustness, and studying adversarial vulnerabilities.
